## Money Tracker — personal money management for Android

**Install:** download `MoneyTracker-*.apk` below on your Android phone (Android 8.0+), open it, and allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser/files app when asked.

What's inside:
- Dashboard with total, available and allocated money, this month's summary, spending donut and budget alerts
- My Money: unlimited custom categories/funds with icon, colour, budget and savings target; add, remove, spend and transfer money
- Income, expenses and transfers with edit/delete, search and filters; calendar view
- Statistics: interactive donut, income vs expenses, daily/weekly/monthly/yearly trends, savings growth, insights
- Monthly reports for any month with comparisons, plus PDF and CSV export
- Goals and monthly budgets with warnings
- Backup/restore (JSON), CSV export, safe reset; light and dark themes; works fully offline, no permissions

Every build is tested on an Android emulator (unit, database, end-to-end UI, persistence across app kill and device reboot, and a smoke test of this exact release APK). See `docs/TESTING.md` in the repository.
